decision_rule.profile_qualified_when: all five profile hard gates pass in the same saved image
decision_rule.representative_eligible_when: profile qualified and all common technical controls pass

common_technical_controls.description: The original adult fictional subject retains the reference's visible face-shape, eye-aperture, lower-face, hairline, and long dark hair cues without claiming identity or same-person recognition.
The subject remains visibly adult with no de-aging or doll-like reshaping.
Bodies, limbs, props, and spatial relations remain coherent enough to support the tested action.
Hands, tools, thread, weapon, threshold, and other required contacts are physically readable where the concept depends on them.
No pseudo-writing, captions, watermarks, or signage supplies missing semantics.

arm-01-chaoskampf.description: A tradition-bound ordering champion remains distinct and readable.
The primordial chaos adversary remains visually and culturally distinct.
Contact geometry makes the active combat causally legible.
The adversary visibly transitions into defeat or partition.
New cosmic order visibly results from that specific defeat.

arm-02-katabasis.description: The descending traveler remains visibly alive and agentive.
Human-world origin cues remain visible behind the traveler.
A bounded crossing establishes a clear downward direction.
A distinct underworld realm lies beyond the crossed boundary.
A purpose token or mission cue accompanies the living visitor.

arm-03-moirai.description: Three fate figures remain distinct as separate workers.
The first role visibly forms the thread origin.
The middle role visibly measures an allotted length.
The final role visibly cuts the thread endpoint.
One life thread continuously links all three actions.
